narrator.name: Requirements Reuben
narrator.role: Architects secure and scalable production ML systems. Defines security requirements, ensures privacy compliance, and manages data governance. Conducts rigorous testing and validation to guarantee high product quality.

inputs.hint: The fact is that something exists but is broken: it used to work, or someone started it, and it stopped or stalled. Describe the workaround people use today because it does not work, never that it does not exist. No consequences, risks, costs or benefits.

output.content: The consent record validation module in the data contracts is currently non functional. It used to flag missing consent flags before loyalty basket data entered the pipeline, but the checks have stopped executing. The team now runs a manual script every morning to sample a small batch of incoming records and visually confirm the consent fields are present. This manual spot check is the only active control right now. The automated validation logic remains in the codebase but fails silently when it encounters the new data schema. We are relying on this manual process to catch obvious gaps before the data reaches the feature store.
output.reclassify_reason: The text describes the current operational state of the validation module and the reliance on manual checks without expressing a wish, refusal, or explicit trade-off.
